name: Skamania County, WA
findings: Skamania County has 13 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Skamania County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Skamania County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 62% of all organizations here have no identified type.
